children: Edwards Lifesciences reported higher third-quarter profit and revenue and raised its full-year outlook, seeing continued increases in procedure volumes.
The company posted net income of $307.5 million, or 53 cents a share, up from $291.1 million, or 50 cents a share, the year prior.
Adjusted earnings were 80 cents a share. Wall Street expected 74 cents a share.
Revenue rose about 11%, to $1.72 billion. Wall Street expected $1.68 billion.

Edwards Lifesciences raised its full-year sales growth guidance to about 12%, up from its previous forecast of 10% to 11%. The company narrowed its adjusted earnings guidance of $2.97 to $3.05 a share, compared with its previous forecast of $2.95 to $3.05 a share.
